title: Котёнок и непослушный блинчик

style.visual: High-quality stylized 3D cartoon animation, adorable rounded characters, colorful family-friendly comedy, soft fluffy fur, expressive eyes, squash-and-stretch animation, cinematic lighting
style.color_palette: Pastel yellow, peach, mint green, warm orange

characters.name: Пончик
characters.appearance: Tiny chubby orange kitten, huge emerald eyes, fluffy cheeks, short paws, pink nose, oversized turquoise chef hat

characters.name: Блинчик
characters.appearance: Golden fluffy pancake with tiny cartoon eyes, a cheeky smile and little springy legs

environment.details: Sunny window, pastel cabinets, wooden breakfast table, colorful dishes, soft morning sunlight

scenes.action: A chubby orange kitten proudly places a giant golden pancake on a plate. The pancake suddenly opens two tiny eyes and winks at the camera.
scenes.camera: Medium shot, quick comedic zoom onto the pancake

scenes.action: The pancake sprouts tiny legs, jumps off the plate and runs across the table. The kitten gasps, eyes expanding comically, then lunges forward and misses.
The pancake leaps onto the kitten's head like a hat. The kitten spins in confusion, slips harmlessly on a soft kitchen mat and lands sitting inside a huge mixing bowl.
scenes.camera: Dynamic medium shot with playful camera movement
scenes.sound: Whoosh! Boing! Gentle cartoon drum roll

scenes.action: The pancake jumps down, pulls out a tiny strawberry and gently places it on the kitten's nose. The kitten goes cross-eyed trying to look at it.
scenes.camera: Close-up of the kitten's hilarious expression

scenes.action: The kitten sneezes! The strawberry flies upward and lands perfectly on the pancake. The pancake proudly poses like a champion. The kitten bursts into a happy giggle.
scenes.camera: Close-up, freeze-frame on the funniest expression

audio.music: Upbeat whimsical cartoon music with pizzicato strings, xylophone and playful percussion
audio.sound_effects: Cartoon boings, pops, squeaks, soft whooshes, funny kitten sneeze

animation_rules: Keep character designs consistent in every scene
Use exaggerated but charming facial expressions
Make visual comedy easy to understand without dialogue
Every scene must have a clear humorous action
Safe, joyful and suitable for young children
